adjudication: Codex v1.14 forensic adjudication and blocking-findings extraction: FOUR BLOCKERs (V114-B1 consumed evidence not bound to governed provenance, V114-B2 diagnostic eligibility reaching commit authority, V114-B3 active authority naming diagnostic entrypoints, V114-B4 governed loader following a symlinked WORKFLOW.json), ONE MERGE MAJOR (V114-M1 malformed nominal carrier leaking AttributeError) and ONE MINOR (V114-N1 canonicalization documentation omitting the location-receipt hash domain). Authority completeness WORKFLOW_CONTRADICTORY; merge FAIL. Hermes's root-existence sensitivity was classified REVIEW_ENVIRONMENT_EFFECT and is NOT treated as a candidate defect.
law: each of the six findings names the v1.14 defect as reproduced against the frozen v1.14 bundle at b61f248238ec7ed60deca79aa9728ec0cde86edd, its root cause, the v1.15 correction, the negative and property fixtures, and the validate_v1_15.py sections that prove it. validate_v1_15.py refuses to pass unless every named section exists and every check in it passes. The essential v1.15 law is THE EXACT BYTES VALIDATED AS GOVERNED EVIDENCE ARE THE EXACT BYTES CONSUMED BY AUTHORIZING DERIVATION.
operational_closure: the v1.14 authorizing-location matrix (V113-B1) is retained as FINDING-RESOLUTION-MATRIX-v1.14.json and its corrections are re-run as v1.15 regressions; this file is the ACTIVE matrix. v1.15 reopens NOTHING else: the v1.12 workflow architecture, the v1.13 governed-root law, Store.v5, the role model, A2V, the lifecycle, the record constructors, BUNDLE semantics, the checked-file law, writer locking, H0, the commit STAGE architecture, the schema-registry architecture, the trusted shim, raw ingestion, the exact stored chain, precedence, the capability matrix, M0B/M0C/M0D and unrelated pre-M3 transaction design are all untouched. tools/evidence_store.py differs from v1.14 by EXACTLY ONE COMMENT LINE (the validator's filename, carried by the tool rename) and by nothing else: every semantic constant is identical - Store.v5, Session.v4, Boundary.v1, Inventory.v4, Finalization.v2, 13 MODE_TABLE entries, 64 error codes, 22 inventory fields, 25 public authority methods and the precedence BOUNDARY > SESSION_STATE > MODEL > READ. What v1.15 does NOT close, stated: the authorizing transaction path has no positive control because no production path authors M3 write evidence, so it is proved fail-closed and proved to apply the ordinary pre-M3 stage laws once provenance passes, and its first true positive belongs to the milestone that freezes write evidence.

findings.severity: BLOCKER (consumed evidence not bound to the validated governed bytes)
findings.codex_finding: The governed carrier has slots but is mutable. Its evidence_set slot can be replaced after canonical loading. Live provenance reopens and hashes canonical EVIDENCE-SET.json against governed.document_sha256, but authorizing derivation consumes governed.evidence_set without proving that it is the object parsed from those checked bytes: validation applies to byte stream A while authorization consumes object B.
findings.prior_defect: Reproduced against the frozen v1.14 bundle at b61f248238ec7ed60deca79aa9728ec0cde86edd before anything was changed, in its sharpest form: two governed sessions were authored at the real canonical root, A fully verified (ATTACHMENT_READY) and B prepared only (PROVISIONED_NOT_VERIFIED); B was loaded; A's evidence set was assigned to B's carrier by ordinary slot assignment; governed_provenance_errors returned [] and derive_attachment_state_authorizing returned ATTACHMENT_READY with authorizing=true, carrying B's own receipt and B's canonical document path while reporting A's session id. That is a FALSE ATTACHMENT_READY under valid governed provenance. In-place mutation of the carrier's stored dict (records 4 -> 0) also passed provenance and changed the derived state.
findings.correction: The carrier holds the exact validated BYTES and no parsed object. __slots__ drops evidence_set and gains document_bytes plus ten provenance fields; the object is frozen after construction (__setattr__/__delattr__ refuse GOVERNED_EVIDENCE_INVALID); evidence_set is a read-only property that strict-parses those bytes afresh on every access and returns a new object; __copy__, __deepcopy__ and __reduce__ refuse, so provenance cannot be cloned out of the loader. A new registered domain vidtoolz.resolveEvidenceSetSnapshot.v1 digests the PARSED content, and that digest is recorded on the carrier and bound into the location receipt. authority_lib.governed_consume(governed, active) is now THE one way an authorizing path obtains semantic evidence: on every call it validates the carrier structurally, revalidates the whole live location, re-reads BOTH authority files no-follow, requires the live digests to equal the minted ones AND the carrier's own bytes to digest identically, strict-parses those exact bytes, schema-validates the parse, requires its snapshot digest to equal the receipt-bound one, re-checks the self-location/production-root/sealed-digest claims, recomputes the receipt, and RETURNS the semantic object. Every authorizing entry point consumes that return value; governed.evidence_set appears in none of them. No authorizing entry point takes a carrier AND a separate evidence argument: there is exactly one evidence authority input.
findings.negative_fixture: validate_v1_15.py section b1-consumed-evidence: immutability of every field, the reparsing property, the single-evidence-source signature audit, a four-step forced-attribute matrix (object.__setattr__ forcing bytes, then digest, then snapshot digest, then receipt of the READY session onto the PREPARED session's carrier - none authorizes), object-identity independence (two carriers for one document are different objects with identical digests and identical results), the source-order proof that the consumed object is the parse of the bytes just read, post-load mutation of the live document refused by derivation, eligibility AND commit, restoration of the exact bytes restoring authority, and a held carrier authorizing nothing once its session is removed; section b1-positive: the MANDATORY positive control at the REAL canonical governed root; section v115-property: 32 seeded cases; section v115-static: the end-to-end statement of the law itself.
findings.expected_layer: authorizing core (consumed evidence bound to validated bytes)

findings.codex_finding: The active transaction/commit authorizers retain a raw evidence-set path. A complete transaction fixture supplied with a bare evidence dict reaches diagnostic eligible=true, passes plan validation, and produces commit_eligibility.eligible=true with all twelve stages completed. This is not a display-only result: diagnostic eligibility influences mutation-plan acceptance and yields a positive commit decision.
findings.prior_defect: Reproduced against frozen v1.14 with the exact artifacts Codex named - fixtures/linked-set/linked-set-committed-consistent.json, fixtures/evidence/write-ready-full.json and fixtures/eligibility/capabilities-hypothetical-refreeze.json, evidence supplied as a bare dict: validate_transaction_set returned [] with stages ['evidence_authority','capability_provenance','schema','s0','plan','journal','s1','delta','effects','verification','conflicts','commit'] and commit_eligibility returned eligible=true. v1.14 had recorded this path as a scoped residual; the final decision it produces is a commit decision, so Codex's BLOCKER classification is correct.
findings.correction: validate_transaction_set_authorizing and commit_eligibility_authorizing are added and require a GovernedEvidenceSet: they consume the bytes-bound snapshot from governed_consume and refuse GOVERNED_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED before any stage runs. semantic_mutation_plan stays INTERNAL_NON_AUTHORIZING but chooses its eligibility law BY TYPE - governed carrier -> evaluate_eligibility_authorizing, bare dict -> the diagnostic gate - never by a caller-supplied callback, which would be the C16-B2 defect class. validate_transaction_set and commit_eligibility are DEMOTED to a fourth surface class, provisional_until_m3_non_authorizing, with the demotion stated in their own docstrings; their behaviour is unchanged and every inherited transaction and commit regression still runs against them. The twelve stages, their order, the internally pinned schemas, S0/S1, journal, delta, effects, verification, conflicts and H0 are untouched: v1.15 adds a provenance gate in front of them and changes no stage law, which is asserted by running both validators over the same legitimate governed carrier and requiring identical stage errors.

findings.codex_finding: The Python surface registry and the M0A binding use the v1.14 split, but the active TARGET-CONTRACT.json (attachment_derivation), PERMISSIONS.json (eligibility law), TARGET-ATTACHMENT-GATE.md and ELIGIBILITY.md still designate the raw diagnostic functions as current/reference authority. Mutually contradictory current instructions coexist, and authority selection is itself an authorizing decision; the report declined to pick a winner and treated the contradiction as blocking.
findings.prior_defect: Reproduced against frozen v1.14 by scanning the active artifacts: TARGET-CONTRACT.json named derive_attachment_state at three places including the attachment_derivation binding, PERMISSIONS.json named evaluate_eligibility in its eligibility law, TARGET-ATTACHMENT-GATE.md named derive_attachment_state as the state function, and ELIGIBILITY.md named evaluate_eligibility as the reference evaluator and derive_attachment_state as the state source.
findings.correction: All four now designate the AUTHORIZING entry points, and the diagnostic pair appears only AS diagnostic - in TARGET-CONTRACT.json in its own field, attachment_derivation_diagnostic_non_authorizing, whose text the schema pins so the classification cannot drift back. AUTHORITY-PRECEDENCE.json carries a blanket clause: where an earlier superseded statement names one of the four bare-evidence functions as the authority of its era, that name now reads as its authorizing counterpart, and S62 records the change. EVIDENCE-SET-WORKFLOW.json and M0A-BINDING-VALUES.json publish all four surface classes from the code itself, so the machine artifacts cannot disagree with the registry.
findings.negative_fixture: validate_v1_15.py section b3-active-naming: an audit that scans EVERY current top-level artifact, machine and prose (50+ documents, not the four Codex found - the precedence table does not even list TARGET-CONTRACT.json or PERMISSIONS.json, so scanning only that table would have missed the defect), requiring that no current artifact names a diagnostic or provisional-until-M3 function except in a clause that marks it as such; the four named artifacts asserted individually; every authority-designated name asserted to be on the authorizing surface and every demoted name asserted not to be; the code registry, the workflow law and the M0A bindings asserted to publish identical class lists; section v115-static: no diagnostic name in any authorizing registry slot.

findings.severity: BLOCKER (governed loader following a symlinked WORKFLOW.json)
findings.codex_finding: Root, session and EVIDENCE-SET.json receive lstat-first checks. WORKFLOW.json is checked only for existence and then opened through strict_load, which follows a symlink. WORKFLOW supplies authority-bearing session/location and evidence-set claims used during provenance minting and records lifecycle/handoff state, so redirecting that read lets foreign bytes participate in authority. Result: ACCEPTED_WORKFLOW_SYMLINK; the loader returned a GovernedEvidenceSet.
findings.prior_defect: Reproduced against frozen v1.14 at the real canonical root: with a valid EVIDENCE-SET.json in place, WORKFLOW.json was replaced by a symlink to a marked foreign file outside the governed root; load_governed_evidence_set returned a GovernedEvidenceSet and derive_attachment_state_authorizing returned ATTACHMENT_READY with authorizing=true. Two further consequences of the same missing law were found that the report did not name: a FIFO at that path BLOCKED THE AUTHORITY INDEFINITELY (open() never returns), and a directory raised a raw IsADirectoryError out of the loader.
findings.correction: One authority-FILE law for both governed files, implemented once in the core and used by both the core and the authoring wrapper: governed_file_errors lstat-classifies the ENTRY before anything is opened (symlink -> <KIND>_SYMLINK_REFUSED and never followed; FIFO, socket, device or directory -> <KIND>_NOT_A_REGULAR_FILE and never opened; then the alias check), and read_governed_file opens with O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK and re-verifies the OPEN FILE by fstat for regular type and matching device and inode, so an entry swapped between check and open is refused rather than trusted. location_errors now checks both files. WORKFLOW.json's bytes are digested, bound into the location receipt and re-checked on every authorizing call, so a post-handoff replacement is detected. evidence_authoring._load was corrected to use the same law, because a defence the core performs and the wrapper does not is the same asymmetry mirrored.
findings.negative_fixture: validate_v1_15.py section b4-workflow-file: a six-case substitution matrix (symlink outside the governed root, symlink to the sibling EVIDENCE-SET.json, symlink to another governed session's workflow, FIFO, directory, dangling symlink), each required to be refused with the exact frozen code by the loader, by the authoring wrapper AND by the published location predicate, with every call bounded by an alarm so a hang cannot be mistaken for a refusal; the receipt-binding assertions; post-load replacement detected; the same law asserted for the evidence document; section v115-property: seeded WORKFLOW path and file-type cases; section v115-static: the no-follow audit.

findings.severity: MERGE MAJOR (malformed nominal carrier leaking a raw exception)
findings.codex_finding: object.__new__(GovernedEvidenceSet) creates an uninitialised nominal instance that passes isinstance. Provenance validation dereferences the missing session_id and leaks a raw AttributeError at both public authorizing boundaries; copy, deepcopy and pickle reach the same nominal state. Malformed external input escapes the frozen result vocabulary and turns an authority decision into an uncontrolled runtime failure.
findings.prior_defect: Reproduced against frozen v1.14 exactly as reported: g = object.__new__(GovernedEvidenceSet) passed to derive_attachment_state_authorizing and to evaluate_eligibility_authorizing raised AttributeError: 'GovernedEvidenceSet' object has no attribute 'session_id' from both.
findings.correction: governed_structure_errors validates the input's exact type (a subclass is refused) and every field with getattr defaults and type checks BEFORE any dereference, and it is called FIRST inside governed_consume, which every authorizing entry point uses. A nominal instance, a subclass, missing slots, None slots, wrong-typed slots and a malformed receipt all fail closed as GOVERNED_EVIDENCE_INVALID; __copy__, __deepcopy__ and __reduce__ refuse so the constructor cannot be bypassed by cloning; and _safe_session_id is used in the refusal payload so even the error path cannot dereference unsafely. Only malformed AUTHORITY INPUT is normalised: a genuine programming error - a wrong-arity call, an unserialisable value - still raises, preserving the v1.10 programming-error distinction, and that distinction is asserted rather than asserted-away.
findings.negative_fixture: validate_v1_15.py section m1-malformed-carrier: a ten-case matrix run against all THREE public authorizing boundaries (attachment derivation, eligibility, commit eligibility) requiring a frozen refusal and no raw exception from each; the exact Codex reproduction pinned separately with its GOVERNED_EVIDENCE_INVALID code; the structure-validator-runs-first source assertion; the programming-error distinction; and the frozen-vocabulary membership of all four new codes; section v115-property: seeded malformed-slot and wrong-type carriers.

findings.severity: MINOR (canonicalization documentation omitting a registered hash domain)
findings.codex_finding: The code registers vidtoolz.resolveLocationReceipt.v1 but CANONICALIZATION.md's closed registered-domain list omits it. No runtime bypass was demonstrated, but the closed-domain authority claim is inaccurate and impairs independent verification.
findings.prior_defect: Reproduced against frozen v1.14 by comparing authority_lib.HASH_DOMAINS with the document. The gap was WIDER than reported: the location-receipt domain plus vidtoolz.resolveEvidenceSessionIdentity.v2, resolveEvidenceRecordKey.v1, resolveEvidenceAttemptKey.v1 and resolveEvidenceBoundary.v1 were absent, and resolveEvidenceSession and resolveEvidenceInventory were documented at superseded versions (.v2 and .v1 against the code's .v4), while the document claimed a closed list.
findings.correction: CANONICALIZATION.md now names every registered domain, including the new vidtoolz.resolveEvidenceSetSnapshot.v1, and says what the two governed-location domains bind. The hash law itself is unchanged. Section hash-domain-parity compares the documented list with authority_lib.HASH_DOMAINS exactly in BOTH directions - no code domain missing from the document, no documented domain the code does not register (the typed-value codec is documented as a codec, not a digest domain) - and the document itself records that this comparison exists, so the omission cannot recur silently.
findings.negative_fixture: validate_v1_15.py section hash-domain-parity: both-direction set equality, the published parity claim, the two governed-location domains documented with what they bind, and the assertion that the receipt digest, the snapshot digest and the evidence-set record digest are three different domains.
